environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the OrderEventConsumer. Messages are published to the SQS queue directly by an internal microservice via SDK calls. No API Gateway sits in front of the publishing path. The SQS queue has no content-based filtering or message attribute validation. The consumer runs with Java 11 (Corretto) with default XML parser settings. The task role has network egress to the internet for pulling container images, and no VPC endpoint restrictions prevent outbound DNS/HTTP.

config.sqs_queue_policy: allow from internal service role and admin role
config.network: public subnet with NAT gateway, unrestricted egress
config.xml_parser: default DocumentBuilderFactory, no feature flags set
config.message_source: direct SDK PutMessage from internal services, no gateway validation
